reason: The issue (bounded-systems/synoptic#4, open, no comments, no assignees/labels) is a single proposal by the maintainer, not a debate: add an embedded-webfont `FontFace` token `{ family, src (data: URI), weight-range, display: swap }` emitted as `@font-face` rules in the generated style.css, keeping the system stack as the default/fallback. With no counter-position on the thread, 'the option the issue converges on' is that proposal. The tokens engine (tokens/*.ts, Deno + Zod) already has a typed `FontFamily` schema and `SYSTEM_FONT_STACKS` in tokens/font.ts that config.ts does not use (config.font is a bare string), and a one-line `--font-sans` token in to-css.ts — so the change is well-scoped: type the font field, optionally add a FontFace block, emit @font-face + a single `--font-sans` var, and mirror into the DTCG/SD JSON. Repo cloned and read; CI gate (deno check + check.ts byte-identical re-derivation of examples/mock-orange and examples/mock-blue) is the verify path.
current_state: Engine is Deno/TypeScript under /tmp/scout/synoptic-4/tokens (deno.json tasks: build-brand, check; imports zod + jsr:@bounded-systems/verbspec). Font today: (1) tokens/config.ts `BrandConfig.font: z.string().default("system-ui, sans-serif")` — a plain string, one line; (2) tokens/font.ts (GENERATED by tokens/gen-font.ts from @webref/css) defines `GenericFontFamily` enum, `SYSTEM_FONT_STACKS` {sans, serif, mono}, a Zod `FontFamily` token ($type 'font-family', $value string[], $generic, $reifiesTo 'CSSStyleValue') and `FontPalette` — but NOTHING imports FontFamily/SYSTEM_FONT_STACKS; they are dead types; (3) tokens/to-css.ts line 53 `const font = tok("font-sans", kw(brand.font));` registers `--font-sans` on :root as a CSSKeywordValue (a whole comma stack mis-modelled as one keyword) and line 65 sets `body { font-family: var(--font-sans) }` — no @font-face anywhere; (4) tokens/to-tokens.ts emits fontWeight and size.font into tokens.dtcg.json / tokens.sd.json but no fontFamily token at all; (5) tokens/audit.ts enforces full indirection (every real property must be var(); px and hex forbidden) — it strips @property blocks but would treat an `@font-face { src: url(data:...) }` block as a rule with DIRECT values and FAIL unless taught to skip @font-face; (6) tokens/check.ts re-derives style.css/tokens.*.json into a temp dir and requires byte-identity with committed tokens/examples/mock-orange and tokens/examples/mock-blue (committed style.css has `--font-sans: system-ui, sans-serif;`), so any output change requires regenerating those fixtures; (7) brand configs: tokens/brands/{burnt-orange,deep-blue,bdelanghe}/brand.json — none sets `font`; (8) the Node site builder build-site.mjs line 136/149/153 has its own hardcoded fallbacks `font-family:${v("font","system-ui,sans-serif")}` / `ui-monospace,monospace` — a second, unrelated source of font-family outside the token engine; (9) CI: .github/workflows/tokens-check.yml runs `deno check *.ts` then `check.ts` for burnt-orange→examples/mock-orange and deep-blue→examples/mock-blue. There is no separate unit-test suite beyond tokens/resolve.test.ts. Node side: package.json script `validate` only.
plan: tokens/gen-font.ts + tokens/font.ts (regenerate, do not hand-edit font.ts): add a Zod `FontFace` token — { $type: 'font-face', family: string, src: string matching /^data:font\/(woff2|woff|ttf|otf);base64,/ (or an array of {src, format}), weight: z.union([number, z.tuple([number, number])]) constrained by WEIGHT_BOUNDS, style: 'normal'|'italic' default normal, display: z.enum(['swap','fallback','optional','block','auto']).default('swap'), $description } and export a `fontStack(face?: string, generic)` helper that builds `[face, ...SYSTEM_FONT_STACKS[generic]]` so the system stack stays the fallback tail.

tokens/config.ts: replace `font: z.string().default('system-ui, sans-serif')` with a typed field that is the single source — e.g. `font: z.object({ family: z.array(z.string()).min(1).default(SYSTEM_FONT_STACKS.sans), generic: GenericFontFamily.default('sans-serif'), faces: z.array(FontFace).default([]) })` (or keep a string form via z.preprocess for back-compat so existing brand.json files parse unchanged and derive identical output).

tokens/to-css.ts: derive the stack from brand.font (+ face family first when faces present), emit ONE `--font-sans` :root token holding the full stack as a CSSStyleValue (fix the current kw() misuse: serialize the array as a comma list, quoting names with spaces), keep `body { font-family: var(--font-sans) }` as the only consumer, and prepend `@font-face { font-family: ...; src: url(data:...) format(...); font-weight: ...; font-display: swap; }` blocks before the @property registrations. Check tokens/serialize.ts / syntaxOf can serialize the stack (add a small case if needed).

tokens/audit.ts: strip `@font-face{...}` blocks the same way @property blocks are stripped (they DEFINE a font, so literal src/weight are expected), and add a check that no `font-family` declaration outside :root holds a direct value (the single-source rule, executable).

tokens/to-tokens.ts: add `fontFamily: { $type: 'fontFamily', sans: { $value: [...] } }` to the DTCG output and `font.family.sans` to the Style Dictionary output, plus the face metadata (family, weights, display; src omitted or included per issue's size call) so the token JSON and CSS agree.

Fixtures: add a small self-contained face fixture (a tiny subset woff2 as data URI in a new brand, e.g. tokens/brands/deep-blue/brand.json or a new tokens/brands/webfont-demo/brand.json + tokens/examples/mock-webfont/) so the @font-face path is exercised by the gate; regenerate tokens/examples/mock-orange and tokens/examples/mock-blue with `deno task build-brand brands/<b>/brand.json examples/<dir>` so check.ts byte-identity passes; add the new brand to .github/workflows/tokens-check.yml.

Docs: update the header comment in tokens/to-css.ts and tokens/GROUNDING.md (CSS Fonts 4 §font-face / font-display grounding) and bump package.json version (0.54.0 → 0.55.0) per the repo's semver habit.

Optional/out of scope unless requested: build-site.mjs lines 136/149/153 keep their own system-stack fallbacks; note this in the PR as the remaining non-token font-family source (the site consumes the generated style.css, so token remains authoritative for the token pipeline).
verify_command: cd tokens && deno check *.ts && deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run check.ts brands/burnt-orange/brand.json examples/mock-orange && deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run check.ts brands/deep-blue/brand.json examples/mock-blue && ! grep -rn 'font-family' examples/mock-orange/style.css examples/mock-blue/style.css | grep -v 'var(--font-sans)' | grep -v '@font-face' | grep -v -- '--font-sans:'
risks: Sandbox cannot run the Deno gate: tokens/verbs.ts imports jsr:@bounded-systems/verbspec and jsr.io returns 403 through the proxy (tested with deno 2.9.6 downloaded from github.com releases; npm registry also refuses the `deno` package). Local verification here would need jsr.io allowed or the dep vendored; otherwise verification only happens in GitHub CI (tokens-check.yml).

The issue has zero comments — 'converges on' is an inference from the single proposal; the maintainer explicitly flagged size/licensing vs zero-load system stack as unresolved. Safest reading: implement FontFace as OPTIONAL with the system stack as default and fallback tail, so existing brands derive byte-identical output where no face is set.

tokens/check.ts demands byte-identical committed fixtures; any serialization change to `--font-sans` (e.g. fixing the kw() misuse) changes examples/mock-*/style.css and requires regenerating and committing them in the same PR.
tokens/audit.ts full-indirection rule will flag @font-face src/weight literals unless the audit is taught to treat @font-face as a definition block.

Data-URI woff2 embedding bloats style.css (tens–hundreds of KB per weight); a fixture face must be a tiny subset with a permissive license (OFL) — avoid shipping Space Grotesk full files in the repo without checking license text.
tokens/font.ts is GENERATED by gen-font.ts (which needs network to @webref/css); edits must go through gen-font.ts or the generator will overwrite them.
build-site.mjs still hardcodes `system-ui,sans-serif` / `ui-monospace,monospace` fallbacks — a reviewer may consider that a second font-family source and ask for it to consume the token.
No GitHub credentials in sandbox: cannot dispatch claim-ticket.yml or comment on the issue; CLAUDE.md requires claiming before working.
